name: threatwall
description: ThreatWall — a live offensive-security & AI-security news wall that aggregates 30+ sources into an auto-rotating, filterable terminal-style dashboard. Bun + TypeScript, zero dependencies.

scripts.restart: bun run stop; sleep 1; bun run start
scripts.start:bg: nohup bun run server.ts > server.log 2>&1 & echo "started (pid $!), logs -> server.log"
